# FP regression fixture

Every reference in this file is a KNOWN false-positive class. driftlint must stay silent.

We use `Next.js` and deploy with Docker. Build with `npm run build`.

Project layout:

```
src/
├── page/
├── types/
└── utils/
```

Settings live in `settings.local.json` and `app.local.yaml`.
Scaffold new inputs as `internal/impl/foo/input.go`, tests as `src/path/to/test.test.ts`.
Build output goes to `dist/` and `builddir/`.
Mappings use the `.csx` extension. LINQ chains like `items.Where(x => x.Id)` reference `x.Id` and `InstanceTransition.Body`.
Versions `1.2.3` and `v2.0.1` are tags; `console.log` is an API, not a file.

Indented tree listings (no box-drawing chars):

```
src/
  utils/
    helpers/
```

Meeting notes go under `Curated/YYYYMM/` folders; template dirs like `TEMPLATE/x.md` are patterns.
We help users make informed decisions, and make sure docs stay honest.
The old runbook lived at `D:\tools\run.sh` on the author's machine.
Example: `src/example-only.ts` shows the pattern (e.g. `lib/sample.ts`).
Reports are written to `./out-reports/` and `state/cache.json` is created if it does not exist.
Start the web app with `cd packages/web && npm run develop`.

The database URL is `file:./prisma/dev.db` and secrets live in `web/.env`.
Finish by moving `Raw/Notes/` to `Archive/Raw/Notes/`.
